responsibility: Implements creation and reuse of the built-in `SIZE` function symbol in the gm2 symbol table. It declares `SIZE` as a built-in procedure returning `ZType`, creates it once with the builtins token location, and re-adds the symbol to later module scopes when needed, providing the front-end symbol identity that special quad and semantic logic use for size-of expressions.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation module for the M2Size pair: it creates the built-in `SIZE` procedure symbol with `MakeProcedure`, sets its result type to `ZType`, and re-adds the existing symbol to the current module scope when reused. Unlike `M2Size.def`, it contains the symbol-table initialization behavior.
